mapper.sql: id, request_id, user_id, stage_goal_id, sub_goal_id, checkin_type, spent_hours, content, evidence_urls, checkin_date, source, is_deleted, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO goal_checkin (id, request_id, user_id, stage_goal_id, sub_goal_id, checkin_type, spent_hours, content, evidence_urls, checkin_date, source, is_deleted) VALUES (#{id}, #{requestId}, #{userId}, #{stageGoalId}, #{subGoalId}, #{checkinType}, #{spentHours}, #{content}, #{evidenceUrls}, #{checkinDate}, #{source}, 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE goal_checkin SET checkin_type = #{checkinType}, spent_hours = #{spentHours}, content = #{content}, evidence_urls = #{evidenceUrls}, checkin_date = #{checkinDate}, source = #{source}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT checkin_type FROM goal_checkin WHERE stage_goal_id = #{stageGoalId} AND sub_goal_id IS NULL AND user_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 0 AND checkin_type IN (2, 3) ORDER BY checkin_date DESC, create_time DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1
